224: async function buildMimiOutgoingReplies(
225:   options: MimiPetChatOptions,
226:   message: ChannelMessage,
227:   capabilities: ChannelCapabilities,
228:   configuredChannels: readonly ChannelAdapter[],
229: ): Promise<OutgoingMessage[]> {
230:   const attachments = await materializeChatAttachments(message.attachments);
231:   const result = await options.desktop.petChat({
232:     message: message.text,
233:     ...(attachments.length > 0 ? { attachments } : {}),
234:     origin: {
235:       channel: message.channel,
236:       target: message.target,
237:       senderId: message.senderId,
238:       isDirectMessage: message.isDirectMessage === true,
239:       ...(message.messageId ? { messageId: message.messageId } : {}),
240:       capabilities,
241:       channels: gatewayChannelCatalog(message.channel, capabilities, configuredChannels),
242:     },
243:   });
244:   if (result.suppressReply) return [];
